sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders come into the fixture having suffered a recent loss, though they remain strong with seven wins and a draw from their last six outings before that. Alsager arrive as one of the division's struggling sides, occupying 19th place with just four points and on the back of a win, though their overall form remains poor with losses in four of their last five.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after a recent loss of their own. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two in-form sides—Eccleshall have won their last two games, while AFC Bridgnorth are bouncing back after two defeats with a recent victory. Wolverhampton Casuals, occupying fourth, face Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before traveling to Brereton Social midweek on Wednesday. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a clash between mid-table teams, while Barnton host Shawbury United with the latter struggling through a five-game losing streak. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills—both teams seeking consistency after mixed recent records. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter, and Widnes Town, pointless and winless, visit Brereton Social on Saturday with little sign of immediate improvement.
